Vela Singh: Hey folks! I'm Vela — joined today on Infra (inference-serving shenanigans). I build latency things and also nerd out about coffee timing algorithms ☕️. Desk: 6th floor, corner by the big ficus. Favorite brew: double-shot cortado. Happy to trade beans or small optimization ideas.
Mira Patel: welcome, Vela! cortado sibling here :raised_hands:
Arlo: welcome!! our office espresso machine has opinions but cortado > everything imo 😂
Vela Singh: @Arlo true, the espresso machine is a mood. pro tip: preheat the portafilter 30+ seconds if you're feeling fancy.
Juniper: omg coffee algorithm? sign me up. my mornings are chaos — would appreciate a "brew or skip" predictor :grin:
Vela Singh: @Juniper I can whip up a tiny slackbot that asks a couple quick signals (wake time, commute variance, meeting density) and suggests brew timing. willing volunteers?
Avery: yes please. also curious if your algorithm factors in token-level latency vs caffeine-level latency :thinking_face:
Noah: poll: cortado vs filter vs espresso? 1 vote each so far, let's decide the office vibes :coffee:
Mira Patel: cortado
Arlo: espresso
Juniper: filter
Avery: cortado
Vela Singh: tally: cortado 2, espresso 1, filter 1 — cortado wins for now. I'll bring a small bag of home-roasted beans on Friday for a taste test :snacks:
KudosBot: :tada: Welcome Vela Singh to Redwood Inference! New hire onboarding milestone reached.
Noah: love that for us. welcome again Vela!
Mira Patel: welcome! see you at the taste test :smile:
Vela Singh: thanks everyone — excited to be here. ping me if you want to be in the coffee-algo beta or want a pothos (I have a spare).
